proc sql; create table data_pa_GC_f as
select t1.Año,t1.trim,(case when t1.id contains 'Activo' then 'Activo' else 'Pasivo' end) as ID, sum(case when t1.moneda= 'USD' then t1.dato*t2.Valor else  t1.dato end) as Dato
left join tc_cierre t2 on t1.año=t2.año and t1.trim=t2.trimestre and t1.moneda=t2.moneda
